errors.assistant_error_codes_luna: all mapped to readable wording; an unknown future code reads 'Claude error: <code>'
errors.result_error_subtypes_luna: mapped; an unknown future subtype ends the turn Errored with fallback wording
errors.rate_limit_event_luna: rejected surfaces a readable error; allowed/allowed_warning stay quiet (warning display owned by cc06)

process.luna_stop: interrupt(cancel_queued) -> wait for the interrupted result -> close stdin -> wait up to kill_grace -> SIGTERM -> SIGKILL; an unresponsive CLI still escalates at interrupt_grace
